description: Statically checks a FiveM resource: Lua syntax, fxmanifest.lua directives and referenced files, resource structure, undeclared dependencies, framework API calls against pinned QBCore/Qbox/ESX versions, unknown natives, net-event security and backdoor patterns. Returns diagnostics with severity, rule code, file and line and a fix. Code is parsed, never run.

files.description: The resource's text files (fxmanifest.lua, Lua, JS, HTML, JSON …) with paths relative to the resource folder. Nothing is executed.

framework.description: Framework to check API calls against; detected from the code when omitted

resource_name.description: Folder name of the resource (used for self-references)

name: validate_resource
title: Validate a FiveM resource
